content.title: Tiger Woods’ dating history: Vanessa Trump and all the other relationships of the golfer
content.text: Not only is Tiger Woods a sporting titan whose numerous records in the world of golf are mind-boggling, but the dating history of the golf icon is also as fascinating as his career. Thus, while his skill on courses around the world is universally lauded, his personal life has been fodder for tabloids for a very long time. For a long time in his career, Woods was seen as the ideal sporting icon. He was happily married and busy with family and golf. Then, one day in 2009, his non-controversial image collapsed like a pack of cards when his extramarital affairs came to light. Woods went off the game for a while and lost major sponsors. Though his tournament victories after 2009 have been few, he continues to be in the news for his relationships. His most recent one? Socialite Vanessa Trump, the former daughter-in-law of US President Donald Trump. Additionally, the American professional golfer is the first from his sport to become a billionaire by net worth, a status he reached in 2022. Currently worth around USD 1.3 billion, according to Forbes, he is one of only two athletes (the other being LeBron James) to have become a billionaire while active. All the relationships of Tiger Woods LeAnn Rimes: Before 2002 Elin Nordegren: 2004-2010 Rachel Uchitel: 2010 Lindsey Vonn: 2013-2015 Kristin Smith: 2015-2016 Erica Herman: 2017-2022 Vanessa Trump: 2025 LeAnn Rimes (Before 2002) Profession: Singer-songwriter How did they meet: Unclear LeAnn Rimes is the first name in the dating history of Tiger Woods. It is not clear when they got close, but an Us Weekly source told the publication in March 2010 that they dated before the Grammy Award winner’s marriage to dancer Dean Sheremet in 2002. The source said that the two “went out a few times”, and Woods was “into her.” However, Rimes’ father objected because she was too young to date the golfer. Rimes divorced Sheremet in 2010 and has been married to actor Eddie Cibrian since 2011. Elin Nordegren (2004-2010) Profession: Mental health counsellor and former model How did they meet: Through golfer Jesper Parnevik Former swimsuit model Elin Nordegren met Tiger Woods in 2001 through Swedish golfer Jesper Parnevik, for whom, according to reports, she was nannying at the time. Their affair quickly developed into a serious romance, and they got married on 5 October 2004 in Barbados in a headline-grabbing ceremony. They welcomed two children over the next five years, daughter Sam Alexis Woods in 2007 and son Charlie Axel Woods in 2009. Tiger Woods and Elin Nordegren with their daughter, Sam.(Image: Courtesy of Tiger Woods/@Tiger via Facebook) Their marriage entered rough waters after the birth of their son in 2009 when Nordegren discovered Wood’s infidelity after details of his private life were published by National Inquirer. The news of the golfer’s unfaithfulness was followed almost immediately by an accident he suffered in his Cadillac SUV while driving away from his Florida home at 2:25 am on 27 November. It was reported in the media that Nordegren used golf clubs to smash the car’s windows to rescue Woods. However, many reportedly assumed that the incident was the result of an altercation. In 2010, Nordegren divorced Woods. By this time, multiple women had spoken up about their relationships with the golfer. Woods issued multiple statements admitting to infidelity and apologising for his actions. At the time, Woods had a net worth of around USD 600 million. He had to pay USD 100 million in divorce settlement, though the figure was initially reported to be around USD 750 million. Despite this, the settlement amount makes it one of the costliest divorces. Nordegren has been in a relationship with former National Football League (NFL) player Jordan Cameron, with whom she has three children. Sometime after their divorce, Woods and Nordegren resumed friendly ties and are reportedly co-parents to their two children. Rachel Uchitel (2010) Profession: Nightclub manager, TV presenter How did they meet: Unclear Rachel Uchitel is the most significant name in the dating history of Tiger Woods precisely because she was in a relationship with the golfer while he was married to his now ex-wife. Uchitel initially denied being in a romantic relationship with Woods, but it turned out to be a lie as Woods admitted to cheating. The affair with Woods did not turn into a permanent relationship. In October 2011, she married former Penn State football player Matt Hahn. Their daughter was born a year later. In 2013, she opened a children’s boutique in Manhattan. However, the Woods affair did turn the spotlight on Uchitel. She appeared in the fourth season of Celebrity Rehab with Dr. Drew and, in 2021, was featured in Tiger — the HBO documentary about Woods. In an interview with Extra, ahead of the release of the documentary, Uchitel spoke about the affair for the first time. “I have been silent for over a decade now, and I felt that it was really important to me to speak only once in my life because I have spent all these years letting people think what they want to think and say what they want to say. I needed to take the shackles off and be able to tell my story for me,” she said. After the premiere of the first episode of the documentary, she gave another interview in which she told Us Weekly that she suffered from “love addiction” during her relationship with Woods. “I keep falling into traps of, you know, either [relationships] that are just maybe [the] wrong timing or people that are not the right people for me at the, at the right time,” she said. Uchitel divorced Hahn in 2014. In March 2025, she announced her engagement to security businessman Dan Donovan. Lindsey Vonn (2013-2015) Tiger Woods and Lindsey Vonn in a picture they released while announcing their relationship. (Image: Courtesy of Tiger Woods/Lindsey Vonn via @Tiger/Facebook) Profession: Olympic skier How did they meet: At a charity event in Las Vegas The fourth well-known name in the dating history of Tiger Woods is Lindsey Vonn, the skier who won a gold medal at the 2010 Winter Olympics. Rumours about their relationship were strong by the time Us Weekly confirmed it in February 2013. According to the publication, they first met at a charity event in 2012. Both Vonn and Woods made their relationship official on 18 March 2013 with simultaneous statements on her Facebook page and his website. “Something nice that’s happened off the course was meeting Lindsey Vonn. Lindsey and I have been friends for some time, but over the last few months we have become very close and are now dating,” wrote Woods and added, “We thank you for your support and for respecting our privacy. We want to continue our relationship, privately, as an ordinary couple and continue to compete as athletes.” Vonn, in her post, said, “I guess it wasn’t a well-kept secret but yes, I am dating Tiger Woods. Our relationship evolved from a friendship into something more over these past few months and it has made me very happy. I don’t plan on addressing this further as I would like to keep that part of my life between us, my family and close friends. Thank you for understanding and your continued support!” The skier, who was married to fellow Olympian Thomas Vonn from 2007 to 2011, grew close to Wood’s children with Nordegren and was often seen with them. At the 2015 New York premiere of the sci-fi romance movie The Age of Adaline, Vonn told PEOPLE, “They [the children] are great. They’re amazing kids, and he’s an amazing father. You know, I feel privileged to be along for the ride, and I help as much as I can. They’re great kids — I love ’em.” However, months later, in May, Woods and Vonn parted ways. In a 2022 interview with Entertainment Tonight, Vonn revealed that she was on friendly terms with Woods. Referring to his 2021 car accident, she said, “We are friends and, of course, I’m happy that he is back and healthy. And, you know, it was a tough time for him. So I am just happy that he is back with his kids.” Kristin Smith (2015-2016) Profession: Businesswoman, personal stylist How did they meet: Unclear Soon after the breakup with Lindsey Vonn, Tiger Woods turned his attention to wardrobe stylist Kristin Smith. But information about their relationship is not as widely reported as most of Wood’s others. It is believed that they started dating sometime in 2015. However, the news broke the following year. Neither Woods nor Smith has ever spoken about their relationship. Yet Woods referred to his break-up with Smith on Twitter (now X) while refuting a Daily Mail report which claimed that they were together during the golfer’s DUI arrest in May 2017. Contrary to the false Daily Mail article, Kristin Smith and I are no longer dating and haven’t since last year. — Tiger Woods (@TigerWoods) August 10, 2017 Smith, too, has maintained silence on the matter. In an interview with D Magazine in March 2017, she said, “I’m happy in my personal life; it’s really full. But I think if I shared it, I’d be damned if I did, damned if I didn’t. I don’t want it to define me.” Almost exactly a year later, TMZ reported that Smith was in arbitration over a non-disclosure agreement she signed with Woods when they broke up. Erica Herman (2017-2022) Profession: Restaurant manager How did they meet: Speculated to be at Woods’ restaurant Next on the list of the dating history of Tiger Woods is Erica Herman. According to Page Six, she first met Woods while working as a general manager at the latter’s flagship restaurant. The exact year of their first meeting is unclear, but the restaurant opened at Harbourside Place in Florida in August 2015. Two years later, in September 2017, Woods and Herman made their relationship official when they appeared together at the President’s Cup. Their first Instagram post dropped in October, showing the pair enjoying a World Series game at Dodger Stadium in Los Angeles. Herman also supported the golfer during his recovery following a February 2021 car accident. However, their relationship on an acrimonious turn when Herman sued Woods over a non-disclosure agreement they had signed in 2017 and also accused him of sexual assault. According to court documents, which were accessed by media houses in May 2023, they had split the previous year. In another lawsuit, she claimed USD 30 million from Woods’ trust, accusing it of violation of an oral tenancy agreement with the golfer that allowed her to live at his residences. Woods denied all the claims made by Herman, including that of sexual assault. Herman dropped both lawsuits by November. She said that she never accused the golfer of sexual harassment or abuse. “In dismissing this action, Erica Herman states that she was never a victim of sexual harassment or sexual abuse at the hands of Tiger Woods or any of his agents and it is her position that she has never asserted such a claim,” wrote attorney Benjamin Hodas in a filing notifying the court of a voluntary dismissal, according to CBS News. Vanessa Trump (2025-) Tiger Woods shared this picture of him and Vanessa on Instagram while confirming their relationship. (Image: Courtesy of Tiger Woods/@tigerwoods via Instagram) Profession: Socialite, former model How did they meet: Unclear, but they have known each other for a long time The most recent name in the long dating history of Tiger Woods is Vanessa Trump. They were first spotted together at a Florida golf tournament in February 2025, but news of the relationship emerged in March, with PEOPLE confirming that they had been “quietly dating for several months”. Vanessa Trump was married to Donald Trump Jr, President Trump’s eldest child, from 2005 to 2018. They have five children, including golfer Kai Trump — the eldest grandchild of President Trump. Kai is only two years younger than Barron Trump, the youngest of the children of President Trump. Before her marriage to Donald Trump Jr, Vanessa was in a relationship with Saudi prince Khalid bin Bandar bin Sultan Al Saud — a member of the House of Saud and current Saudi Arabian ambassador to the UK. The Daily Mail, which was the first to report on the affair, revealed that the children of Woods and Vanessa Trump study in the same school in Florida. On 23 March, around a week after the publication of the reports, Woods confirmed his relationship with Vanessa in an Instagram post. “Love is in the air and life is better with you by my side! We look forward to our journey through life together. At this time we would appreciate privacy for all those close to our hearts,” Woods wrote in the caption. The post carried two pictures, one showing them standing side by side with their arms around each other and the other capturing them as they cuddled up in a lounge chair. On 31 March, President Trump expressed his approval of the relationship. “He [Woods] told me about it [the relationship], and I said, ‘Tiger, that’s good, that’s good.’ I’m very happy for both. Just let them both be happy. Let them both be happy. They’re both great,” Trump said. (Hero image: Courtesy of Tiger Woods/@Tiger via Facebook; Featured image: Courtesy of Tiger Woods/@tigerwoods via Instagram)The information in this article is accurate as of the date of publication.
